## API Reference: Project Tags
- [List](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/project_tags-list.md): List the tags assigned to a project, sorted by name. Anyone who can view the project can list its tags.
- [Assign](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/project_tags-assign.md): Assign an existing tag to a project. Requires the `enclave_project_tags_manage` project permission. A project can have up to 100 tags.
- [Unassign](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/project_tags-unassign.md): Remove a tag from a project. The tag itself isn't deleted. Requires the `enclave_project_tags_manage` project permission.

## API Reference: Tags
- [List](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/tags-list.md): List the tags in your workplace, sorted by name. Any member of the workplace can list tags.
- [Retrieve](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/tags-get.md): Retrieve a tag. Any member of the workplace can retrieve tags.
- [Create](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/tags-create.md): Create a tag. Requires the `tags_create` workplace permission. A workplace can have up to 100 tags.
- [Update](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/tags-update.md): Rename a tag or change its color. You must specify at least one of `name` or `color`. A tag's slug can't be changed. Requires the `tags_update` workplace permission.
- [Delete](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/tags-delete.md): Delete a tag. A tag can't be deleted while it's assigned to any project, so remove it from every project first. Requires the `tags_delete` workplace permission.

## API Reference: Configs
- [Object](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-object.md): Config
- [List](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-list.md): Fetch all configs.
- [Create](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-create.md): Create a new branch config.
- [Retrieve](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-get.md): Fetch a config's details.
- [Update](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-update.md): Modify an existing config.
- [Delete](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-delete.md): Permanently delete the config.
- [Clone](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-clone.md): Create a new branch config by cloning another. This duplicates a branch config and all its secrets.
- [Lock](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-lock.md): Prevent the config from being renamed or deleted.
- [Unlock](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-unlock.md): Allow the config to be renamed and/or deleted.
- [Inheritable](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-inheritable.md): Update the inheritability of a config.
- [Inherits](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/configs-inherits.md)

## API Reference: Share
- [Plain Text](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/share-secret.md): Generate a Doppler Share link by sending a plain text secret. This endpoint is not end-to-end encrypted as you are sending the secret in plain text. At no point do we store the plain text secret or…
- [E2E Encrypted](https://docs.doppler.com/reference/share-secret-encrypted.md): Generate a Doppler Share link by sending an encrypted secret. The receive flow the user goes through will be end-to-end encrypted where the encrypted secret will be decrypted on the browser.
